name: Salvebringer Ninjas
description:
About This Game

※The TGS Tokyo Game Show special stage for “Salvebringer Ninjas” is now available for testing! Players who wish to try it out can click to join the “Playtest.” The game is still in an early stage of development. We’ll continue to update and improve it to provide players with a better experience.

Game Overview

Haruse is a young kunoichi who secretly left her ninja village to experience the outside world for the first time. She figured it would just be a run-of-the-mill training journey...until a bizarre infection breaks out in the once-peaceful town.

The legendary Salvebringer Ninjas must rise again! Haruse fights alongside the alluring Oboro, battling her way through dangerous districts, forgotten facilities, and heavily fortified enemy strongholds to drive back the relentless Ghoul Corps.

But as they track down the mastermind behind the mysterious infection, every clue points toward a far greater conspiracy—and reveals a hidden secret connected to Haruse herself.

After overcoming countless battles and trials, will Haruse find the true path of the ninja, and protect the person she holds most dear?

Game Features

  • Fast-paced, exhilarating hack-and-slash combat

  • Take on powerful, uniquely designed bosses

  • Purchase gear and learn new techniques to grow into a stronger ninja

  • Play as the kunoichis Haruse or Oboro, each with a distinct combat style!

Character

Haruse

A 20-year-old prodigy kunoichi who is cheerful and optimistic, with a mastery of ice ninjutsu. However, the village chief's overprotectiveness has kept her from passing the official ninja trial.
Naive about love, she's also confused and uneasy about the process behind the village's secret, generations-old "Ultimate Ninjutsu"...

Oboro

A 28-year-old, seductive Jonin who has mastered the ninjutsu of social engineering men and women.

Having endured betrayal in love, she has long since given up on romance, and can use her body as a weapon without so much as a flicker of hesitation.
short_desc: As the outbreak spreads and civilization crumbles, humanity's last hope rests with an order of mysterious ninjas that have been hiding from the world for decades—the Salvebringer Ninjas!
